name: Daily summary (07:00 IST)
prompt: Give me a short daily summary: unread urgent email, calendar for the next 2 hours, and any stuck todos. Keep it under 10 lines.
scheduleNote: Daily 07:00 Asia/Kolkata — Worker cron 30 1 * * * (01:30 UTC) wakes QwenPaw; the work itself runs as a NATIVE QwenPaw cron job (see native-cron-jobs.example.json).

name: Inbox check every 30 min
prompt: Check the inbox for anything urgent that arrived in the last 30 minutes. Only report if something needs my attention; otherwise stay silent.
scheduleNote: Every 30 min — Worker cron */30 * * * * wakes QwenPaw; the work itself runs as a NATIVE QwenPaw cron job. Paused by default: enable only after creating the matching native job.
